title: Former Robinhood engineer pleads guilty to insider trading scheme on Hyperliquid
summary: Huaisong Xiang admitted using confidential crypto listing information to make $125,523 trading perpetual futures on Hyperliquid.

title: Bitcoin risks falling below $60,000 as Nvidia earnings threaten to deepen crypto sell-off
summary: Rising bond yields, ETF outflows and forced selling are weighing on bitcoin as traders brace for more losses.

title: U.S. Senate Democrats tell CFTC to back off its demand prediction markets defy bans
summary: The Commodity Futures Trading Commission directed platforms such as Kalshi to defy state bans, but the Democrats want it to reverse course, citing court orders.

title: Lighter suspends all withdrawals after $10.4 million crypto exploit
summary: The decentralized exchange blamed a leaked trading API key and said its smart contracts were unaffected, while investigators traced funds to Hyperliquid.

title: Brazil's central bank faces backlash over stablecoin money laundering remarks
summary: A central bank official reportedly said legitimate funds become tainted when moved into stablecoins, comparing the market to the informal "dólar-cabo" system.
